result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up convergence under impl-lead ruling 012: rechecked the updated Story 1 scope/mapping docs against the current `convex/archiveEntries` and `convex/archiveEntries.test.ts` surfaces, then reran the targeted Story 1 test and the configured story gate to validate current readiness.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Impl-lead ruling 012 and the updated story/test-plan/tech-design text now consistently judge Story 1 on the primitive append/read boundary only. The story now rewrites AC-1.1 and AC-1.4 to primitive-level behavior and maps TC-1.1a/b/c and TC-1.4a/b to `convex/archiveEntries.test.ts` (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/stories/01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:51-97`, `156-178`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/test-plan.md:44-54`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/tech-design.md:563-569`). The prior scope dispute is closed.

The prior `collect()`-then-slice observation no longer applies because the cited `listArchiveEntries` implementation is not present in the current `convex/archiveEntries.ts`. That concern is superseded by the new blocking regression below: the Story 1 append/read primitive exports are now absent entirely.

newFindings.title: The current archiveEntries module no longer exports the Story 1 append/read primitive, and the story gate now fails
newFindings.evidence: `convex/archiveEntries.ts` currently contains only validators and `archiveEntriesTableFields` (`convex/archiveEntries.ts:1-45`); it does not export `appendArchiveEntry` or `listArchiveEntries`. `convex/archiveEntries.test.ts` still imports those symbols at `convex/archiveEntries.test.ts:1-3`, so the targeted Story 1 test now fails immediately with `_handler` undefined, and `corepack pnpm run green-verify` fails in typecheck with `TS2305: Module './archiveEntries.js' has no exported member 'appendArchiveEntry'` and `listArchiveEntries`. A repo search over `convex` and `apps/platform` found no replacement mutation/query export for these primitive functions. This removes the executable Story 1 persistence surface and breaks the configured story gate.

productionPathFindings: `convex/archiveEntries.ts` no longer provides the real Story 1 runtime path for archive entry append/read; only schema validators remain, so the production primitive itself is missing.
additionalObservations: The earlier human-ruling blocker is closed: the story, tech design, and test plan now consistently scope Story 1 to primitive append/read behavior only.

No fake adapter, shim, or placeholder execution branch was found in the current runtime surface; the blocking issue is that the runtime primitive exports are absent, not that a fake path replaced them.
